sessions.name: Login Sessions
sessions.command: $since = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-{{minutes}}); $typeMap = @{'2'='Interactive';'3'='Network';'4'='Batch';'5'='Service';'7'='Unlock';'10'='RDP';'11'='CachedRDP'}; Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4624; StartTime=$since} -MaxEvents 200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $e = $_; $d = ([xml]$e.ToXml()).Event.EventData.Data; $user = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'TargetUserName').'#text'; $domain = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'TargetDomainName').'#text'; $ip = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'IpAddress').'#text'; $typeName = $typeMap[($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'LogonType').'#text']; if ($typeName -and $user -notlike '*$' -and $user -ne 'SYSTEM' -and $user -ne 'ANONYMOUS LOGON' -and $user -notlike 'DWM-*' -and $user -notlike 'UMFD-*' -and $domain -ne 'NT AUTHORITY' -and $domain -ne 'Window Manager' -and $domain -ne 'Font Driver Host') { "$($e.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) $domain\$user type=$typeName from=$ip" } }

failed_auth.name: Failed Authentication
failed_auth.command: $since = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-{{minutes}}); Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4625; StartTime=$since} -MaxEvents 200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $e = $_; $d = ([xml]$e.ToXml()).Event.EventData.Data; $user = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'TargetUserName').'#text'; $domain = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'TargetDomainName').'#text'; $ip = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'IpAddress').'#text'; $reason = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'FailureReason').'#text'; "$($e.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) FAILED $domain\$user from=$ip reason=$reason" }

sudo_commands.name: Elevated Process Creation
sudo_commands.command: $since = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-{{minutes}}); Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4688; StartTime=$since} -MaxEvents 500 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $e = $_; $d = ([xml]$e.ToXml()).Event.EventData.Data; if ((($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'TokenElevationType').'#text') -eq '%%1937') { $user = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'SubjectUserName').'#text'; $proc = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'NewProcessName').'#text'; $cmdline = ($d | Where-Object Name -eq 'CommandLine').'#text'; if ($user -ne 'SYSTEM' -and $user -notlike '*$') { "$($e.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) USER=$user COMMAND=$proc $cmdline" } } }

file_changes.name: File Changes
file_changes.command: $since = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-{{minutes}}); $paths = @("$env:SystemRoot\System32\drivers\etc", "$env:SystemRoot\System32\Tasks", "$env:ProgramData\ssh", "$env:SystemRoot\System32\GroupPolicy"); foreach ($p in $paths) { if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem -Path $p -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -gt $since } | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 100 | ForEach-Object { "$($_.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) $($_.FullName)" } } }

reboots.name: Reboots
reboots.command: $since = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-{{minutes}}); $map = @{6005='STARTUP';6006='CLEAN SHUTDOWN';6008='UNEXPECTED SHUTDOWN'}; Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=6005,6006,6008; StartTime=$since} -MaxEvents 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) $($map[[int]$_.Id])" }

package_changes.name: Software Changes
package_changes.command: $since = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-{{minutes}}); Get-WinEvent -ProviderName msiinstaller -MaxEvents 200 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TimeCreated -gt $since } | ForEach-Object { "$($_.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) $($_.Message -replace '\r?\n',' ')" }; Get-HotFix -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.InstalledOn -and $_.InstalledOn -gt $since } | ForEach-Object { "$($_.InstalledOn.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) HOTFIX $($_.HotFixID) $($_.Description)" }

service_changes.name: Service Changes
service_changes.command: $since = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-{{minutes}}); $map = @{7045='NEW SERVICE';7036='STATE CHANGE';7040='START TYPE CHANGED'}; Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=7045,7036,7040; StartTime=$since} -MaxEvents 100 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "$($_.TimeCreated.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) $($map[[int]$_.Id]) $($_.Message -replace '\r?\n',' ')" }
